steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: MBCC... sounds like just another one of DisCity's attack dogs.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: But I'm afraid you've wasted your effort. There's nothing left for you here.
Without warning, an invisible force slams into your chest, driving the air from your lungs and forcing you to your knees.

Across from you, Hilda's form shudders. In response, the surrounding Mania—now a thick, oily sludge—heaves into motion. It lashes out like a living thing, wrapping around your limbs and coiling around your throat with shocking speed.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: From the moment I was caught, my only purpose was to die cleanly. On my own terms.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: What you've captured is just a hollowed-out "shell."

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...This is for the best... A clean end is all I wanted.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Now, goodbye. Don't even bother. I'd rather die than be DisCity's new dog.
In an instant, you are submerged in the choking, black tide. Your lungs scream for air that doesn't come.

Your frantic struggles are useless against the sludge's grip. Your vision sparks with violent, chaotic colors, and the iron taste of blood fills your mouth. As the last of your strength ebbs, your movements become weak, uncoordinated twitches. The darkness at the edge of your sight swells, consuming everything, until finally, your body goes still.
